answer: Locks are published in lantern, expire in ember, and prism lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 102 aliases hence needs 145 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3417 identities would post 958 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
